title: Zone Equalisation Normalisation For Improved Alignment of Epigenetic Signal
authors: Wilson T; Milne TA; Riva SG; Hughes JR
one_liner_zh: 该文提出表观遗传信号归一化方法ZEN，属于基因组数据处理技术，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模或TF-DNA结合机制，与本课题无关。
abstract: High-throughput genomic technologies have transformed our understanding of biological systems, but analysing these complex datasets remains challenging. Existing normalisation methods often struggle to accurately correct for technical variations across different experimental conditions, potentially leading to misleading biological interpretations. We introduce Zone Equalisation Normalisation (ZEN), a novel approach designed to improve signal normalisation across genomic datasets. By developing a flexible method that reduces technical noise whilst preserving biological signals, ZEN addresses critical limitations in current normalisation techniques. By applying ZEN to diverse genomic techniques, we reveal its robust performance in managing technical variations across different experimental platforms. ZEN provides researchers with a robust tool for more accurate and reliable genomic data analysis, potentially revealing biological insights that were previously obscured by technical variations.
abstract_zh: 高通量基因组技术已深刻改变了我们对生物系统的理解，但分析这些复杂数据集仍具挑战性。现有标准化方法往往难以准确校正不同实验条件下的技术变异，可能导致误导性的生物学解释。我们引入了区域均衡标准化（Zone Equalisation Normalisation, ZEN），这是一种旨在改善基因组数据集信号标准化的新方法。通过开发一种灵活的方法，在减少技术噪声的同时保留生物信号，ZEN解决了当前标准化技术中的关键局限性。将ZEN应用于多种基因组技术，我们展示了其在管理不同实验平台技术变异方面的稳健性能。ZEN为研究人员提供了一个强大的工具，用于更准确、可靠的基因组数据分析，可能揭示先前被技术变异掩盖的生物学见解。
